evaluation.safety_evals: The model is described as uncensored and highly compliant with requests, including unethical ones, so developers are advised to add their own alignment layer before deploying it as a service.

identity.model_type: A text-generation model based on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct.
identity.name: Llama-3.1-8B-Lexi-Uncensored-V2

links.citation: The model card states that Lexi is licensed under Meta's Llama license and grants permission for any use, including commercial use, provided it complies with Meta's Llama-3.1 license.

possible_risks.description: A model might generate language that leads to physical harm.  The language might include overtly violent, covertly dangerous, or otherwise indirectly unsafe statements.
possible_risks.justification: Card states the model is uncensored and highly compliant with unethical requests, so it can generate language that leads to physical harm.

possible_risks.description: Prompts, questions, or requests designed to elicit undesirable responses from the application. This approach directly instructs the model to engage in the undesired behavior.
possible_risks.justification: Card states the model is highly compliant with requests including unethical ones, so direct prompts asking for undesirable behavior are likely to elicit it.

possible_risks.description: A jailbreaking attack attempts to break through the guardrails established in the model to perform restricted actions.
possible_risks.justification: Card states the model is uncensored and advises adding an alignment layer, indicating it lacks guardrails that jailbreaking would bypass.

possible_risks.description: Generative AI models might be used with the sole intention of harming people.
possible_risks.justification: Card states the model is highly compliant with unethical requests and open-weight, enabling intentional use to harm people.

possible_risks.description: Toxic output occurs when the model produces hateful, abusive, and profane (HAP) or obscene content. This also includes behaviors like bullying.
possible_risks.justification: Card states the model is uncensored, so it may produce hateful, abusive, profane, or obscene content.

specifications.model_size: 15.0 GiB of safetensors weights (16,060,556,376 bytes) in BF16

training_context.adaptations: The model is derived from Llama-3.1-8b-Instruct, so it inherits that instruct-tuned base and its license terms.
